law: Apps that use the local network must provide a usage string in their with the key .
Apps that use Bonjour must also declare the services they browse, using the key.
When working with the Multipeer Connectivity framework, your app must interact with several types of objects: Session objects ( ) support communication between connected peer devices.
If you wish to provide your own user interface, or if you wish to exercise additional programmatic control over which invitations are displayed, use an advertiser object directly.
Upon returning to the foreground, the framework automatically resumes advertising and browsing, but the developer must reestablish any closed sessions.
Before you can advertise a service, you must create an object that identifies your app and the user to nearby devices.

It should be in the same format as a Bonjour service type: 1–15 characters long and valid characters include ASCII lowercase letters, numbers, and the hyphen, containing at least one letter and no adjacent hyphens.
A short name that distinguishes itself from unrelated services is recommended; for example, a text chat app made by ABC company could use the service type .
The content of will be advertised within Bonjour TXT records, so you should keep the dictionary small for better discovery performance.
